description:
Native V/O copier with all four queries routed to the equals source.

Only Q/K projection weights and their RMS gains are installed at layer7.
The value map, output map, and post-attention gain remain exactly native.
Readout scaling is a coordinate convention for the subsequent amplifier.

extra.field_representation: Native all-head copy readout in a conditionally cleared frame

routing.metric: Centered paired causal QK score error, no attention softmax or model replay

reference_report.target: raw-state constant on current continuation positions; no numeric answers

frame_geometry.target: Literal coordinate readout identities on existing source registers, no arithmetic labels

frame_analysis.target: Literal coordinate readout identities on existing source registers, no arithmetic labels
